known_unknowns: Consumer-edge coverage for M01-M05, M07, and M09 is incomplete where no active standalone module contract exists.
Only directly cited consumer relationships are present; absence of an edge is NOT VERIFIED as absence of a dependency.
Targeted regression assignments are intentionally NOT VERIFIED until the graph is accepted and test authority is mapped.

current_owner_source_overlay.purpose: Current-source lexical audit overlay; does not mutate the accepted module graph authority or its verified consumer-edge set.
limitations: M11J is a source header and is listed in this overlay; the accepted graph's module key set remains governed by its existing schema.
Field access is lexical and type-level. Multiple modules accessing the same struct type and field does not prove that they access the same object instance.
Interprocedural by-reference/copy alias effects and field consumer ownership remain PARTIAL; no dependency absence is inferred.
